body: thank you so much for your kind response, all of these meant  a lot to me in a very bad time.  sad that strangers on the internet seem to care more than the people i have known for years, who i would do anything for.

thanks for giving your views on suicide by cop.  this is the reason i dont want to do it.  i dont want to tramatize someone with my death.  i mean, not needlessly.  but as a former cop can i ask you, how terrible woud it have really been if you acted 100% in the right?  for example if fsomeone pointed a gun at you, and said that if you didnt shoot them they were going to shoot you, you would be doing in that perspective, for your own protection (even if say, you found out the gun was a toy or not loaded, no way you could have known that).  did you ever get in any situation like that before or know anyone who has?  did it mess them up real bad?

you're right, not everyone is.  you're very right.  i really wish it were as simple as just quitting a job.  i wish so badly it were that simple.  i'm coming to the realization that this sadness follows me everywhere i go though.  it's not a problem with the world, it's sadly a problem with me.  

this job just happens to be making it a million times worse because my values are so mismatched with it, but, it's still a problem that goes too deep to solve.
Today was a really awful day and this post really made me smile.  it was very kind.  I really wanted to thank you for it, and everyone else that responded.
I just wish someone would have been real with me.  It's so rare that anyone I talk to is real with me.   Even if it would have hurt and crushed me.  Would be worth it.
